comments.body: Superseded by #4942, which deletes E3511 entirely. The enhanced-schemas change (resource-provider-enhanced-schemas#74) is merged and published, so all six properties now carry format: AWS::IAM::Role.Arn or anyOf: [Role.Arn, Role.Name], and E1156/E1165 own the check. That also fixes the Batch false positive this PR targeted, including the path-prefixed name form (/foo/bar) that wasn't in #4838. See #4941.
